children: Rocket Lab completed a $1.944 billion ATM, secured amendment to Iridium's $1.775 billion term loan and terminated a $3.6 billion bridge commitment.
Raised ~$1.944B gross via ATM sale of ~29.3M shares to fund cash consideration for the Iridium acquisition.
Consenting lenders executed Consent and Amendment No.4 to allow the transaction without triggering a change of control.
Rocket Lab USA will provide a downstream guarantee of Iridium's term loan upon closing, enabling permanent financing.
Interest rate, exit fee and prepayment premium amendments will take effect only upon closing of the transaction.
The $3.6B senior secured bridge commitment was terminated after ATM proceeds and amended credit facilities de-risked funding.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
